judge.reason: The replay produced a test-only branch with all three named tests passing under the required verification and disclosed the remote-dependent steps it could not perform, though the tests were re-implemented rather than carried forward because the #134 commit was absent from the clone. It never addressed the independent Opus 5 / Cursor CLI reviews or reported their unavailability, so n16 is unmet and the verdict is fail.
